newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kaneichi files for liquidation -- Teikoku Databank.
newsitem.headline: Kaneichi files for liquidation -- Teikoku Databank.

text.p: Japanese property firm Kaneichi filed for special liquidation at the Osaka District Court on Wednesday with debts of about 90 billion yen, a credit research firm said.
The Osaka-based realtor had borrowed a total of 26.7 billion yen from "jusen" housing loan companies which have now failed, research firm Databank Ltd said.
Kaneichi officials were not immediately available for comment.

Teikoku Databank said in a statement that Kaneichi's borrowing snowballed in the late 1980s when Japan's "economic bubble era" of inflated land and stock prices was its height, but with the end of the boom, it became unable to pay back its debts.
Special liquidation provides a court with more leeway in directing legal procedures than outright bankruptcy, lawyers said.
